'''Temesher''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a large amount of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] was discovered on Temesher underneath a [[Temesher graveyard|graveyard]] used by the natives' warriors.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Blades to Be}}</ref>
